verdict.rationale: Galileo's MCP server explicitly supports creating/managing datasets and running experiments programmatically from a dev environment (galileo-docs-4, galileo-docs-31, galileo-docs-32), and the Python SDK/experiments framework lets code trigger evals against metrics (galileo-docs-2). However, no evidence explicitly shows an agent reading back structured eval results via MCP or API call (no OpenAPI spec found, galileo-probe-3), so the full round-trip loop is only partially documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an MCP/API call retrieving eval run results back to the agent, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the full create-run-read cycle.
